# Phase Three — Tiferes Final Execution Plan

The Awtsmoos joins semantic light and encoded vessel; Awtsmoos.com will let the same movie remain editable before it becomes bytes at the final level.

## Source files to create
- `apps/animator/src/studio/export/browser/CanonicalMovieFrameSource.js` — independent canvas + shared `CanvasMovieRenderer`, exact millisecond capture contract.
- `apps/animator/src/studio/export/browser/CanonicalMovieBrowserExport.js` — validate/project canonical movie, create export manifest, invoke existing controller with canonical frame source.
- `apps/animator/tools/browser-export/CanonicalThreeMinuteExportPage.js` — page controller for acceptance film and export state.
- `apps/animator/tools/browser-export/canonicalThreeMinuteRenderer.html` — dedicated proof UI shell, worker script environment, production-independent canonical renderer.
- optional `apps/animator/tools/browser-export/CanonicalMovieBlobPersistence.js` only if browser download cannot be retrieved reliably through tunnel control.

## Existing files eligible for whole rewrite only if required
- `apps/shared/movie/examples/FeatureScene.js` only after voice compatibility discovery if adding dialogue/captions.
- `apps/shared/movie/index.js` only if a new export-facing shared API genuinely belongs there; otherwise avoid coupling shared core to Animator.

## Verification files to create after source freeze
Focused tests under `apps/shared/movie/tests/` and `apps/animator/tests/sharedMovie/`, each below 120 lines and each testing public observable contracts.

## Runtime sequence
1. Launch a local static server for the Geelooy root.
2. Launch/navigate Chrome through the tunnel.
3. Load canonical proof page and inspect readiness.
4. Run short export first to prove encoder/frame-source wiring.
5. ffprobe short proof.
6. Run full 180-second export at 640×360/12fps.
7. Persist/retrieve MP4.
8. ffprobe exact duration and streams.
9. Extract seven distant frames with ffmpeg and hash/analyze them.
10. Browser-test mobile director at narrow viewport.
11. Reread source, write delta, fix, rerun.

## Completion gate
No final completion claim until real output media and verification artifacts exist and REMAINING_WORK contains no safe unresolved node.
